title.value: Automate freelance lead scoring, follow-ups and invoicing

introduction.value:
A freelancer used n8n and ChatGPT to automate lead scoring, email follow-ups, invoice reminders and CRM updates, saving 30-40 hours per month.
·
Mar 1, 2025

method.value: The poster says they used n8n, ChatGPT, Notion and email to automate lead scoring and follow-ups, GPT-based proposal generation, invoice reminders, CRM updates, and weekly project reports for a freelance web design and development agency. They built it visually rather than coding, mostly by adapting free n8n templates and learning from YouTube tutorials, with help from their team as they kept refining the workflows.

outcome.value: They report saving 30–40 hours per month and say the agency had a heavy enough proposal load for the automation to matter. The thread stays high-level, though, and does not spell out the exact scoring rules, prompts, or workflow logic.

notes.value: Their main practical advice was to start from free n8n templates and tutorials instead of building from scratch; they also said they began on a trial and then upgraded.

Automate freelance lead scoring, follow-ups and invoicing
A freelancer used n8n and ChatGPT to automate lead scoring, email follow-ups, invoice reminders and CRM updates, saving 30-40 hours per month.
·
Mar 1, 2025
Done with
N8
n8n
GP
ChatGPT
What they did
The poster says they used n8n, ChatGPT, Notion and email to automate lead scoring and follow-ups, GPT-based proposal generation, invoice reminders, CRM updates, and weekly project reports for a freelance web design and development agency. They built it visually rather than coding, mostly by adapting free n8n templates and learning from YouTube tutorials, with help from their team as they kept refining the workflows.
How it went
They report saving 30–40 hours per month and say the agency had a heavy enough proposal load for the automation to matter. The thread stays high-level, though, and does not spell out the exact scoring rules, prompts, or workflow logic.
Worth knowing
Their main practical advice was to start from free n8n templates and tutorials instead of building from scratch; they also said they began on a trial and then upgraded.
Try it yourself
with
n8n
Copy prompt
Build an n8n workflow for my freelance business that scores new leads from [source, e.g. contact form] using an AI step based on [criteria, e.g. budget, timeline, fit], sends a follow-up email draft for [score threshold] leads, reminds clients about unpaid invoices from [invoicing tool], and updates my CRM [CRM name]. Save emails as drafts for my approval instead of sending them. You're done when I can run a test lead through the whole flow.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/automation/comments/1jsbaks/i_automated_most_of_my_freelance_workflow_with
